title: Girale naqboyti
intro: maybalaalaqak naharsi ayroorah addat, nummak giddile saduh yan numih muuci yooboke. Gadda kee caddot barkat le, ta rooci miraaciino dooritteh, ken xaagi suurah ellecabo aayatitteh addal kaxxa maabitina yekke.
clues: Anu Nabiyyi elle yan magaalal sugeeh, kaah xayih yan marak numuk teyna kinniyo, takkay immay yi kaxxa mari nummak yoo yeyyeeqeh.
Anu kaxxa gadda kee mango uwwayti liyooh, yi gadditte umman way yoo dacriseleemih akkal liyo.
farmo baxxaqimte wak, anu qaduuk tet anqasak wonnah uduureh, inni mu'miniinuk daga exceh.
Yi naqboyti kaxxam muxxo luk sugeeh, Qur'aanak suura saanih yoo yaabeeh, gersi mari yoo yaaxige migaq yoh seecak suge.
Anu inni gadda kee yi culenta yoh tuxxiq alle waytam kee anu laqlaqta girat qideyyom yok takkawsimeh suge.
Anu girah abba exceh aaxigem kee yi barra gira caxxi akat fillat hayya hayteh quuka.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: isi gadda weeh takkay immay kunnabnat rabe

arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
verse: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained. (111:2)
